integration.humanScaleRationale: 1.5 world units per source meter; 2.8-unit Nightweaver visual approximates a 1.85-1.9 m adult.
integration.waterMesh: hidden; Skyreach animated ocean remains authoritative
integration.performance: lazy-loaded near SPI; 1.50 human-relative uniform scale; bridge Y correction 23.8/26.43; lighthouse-only Y correction 21.95/25.83; local visibility radius 18000; clear-weather SPI fog extends to 18000; vegetation and jetties hidden on Auto/Low/Medium and restored on High
integration.portIsabelVehicle: Dedicated boardable sports car visual/fallback scaled 1.5; holder and marker remain unscaled; parked at Port Isabel road start facing the continuous causeway route; Explore points to the car.
integration.contextDressing: Instanced low-rise fillers and palms are illustrative game context, not survey-accurate geometry.
integration.anchorNote: Full-scale Port Isabel is offset east to avoid overlap with the original Skyreach island; internal source geometry and causeway alignment are preserved.
